AssetVariant.description: A selectable realized item. Requires lineage refs (conceptRef + meshRef) and ≥1 Swatch.
AssetVariant.title: AssetVariant

BBox.description: An axis-aligned bounding box (donor rescale target, §8) — two cardinality-pinned corners.
BBox.title: BBox

BlenderJob.description:
Inputs the sidecar hands the Blender CLI subprocess (§8). ``meshPath`` is a scratch-path ref;
``params`` is the open, job-specific knob bag (the adapter/worker interprets it).
BlenderJob.title: BlenderJob

BlenderJobStatus.description:
Terminal status of a Blender mesh job (§8). The §17 hang-watchdog kill→retry is impl; the
terminal status is what the report carries.
BlenderJobStatus.title: BlenderJobStatus

BlenderReport.description:
The Blender worker result (§8). Outputs are scratch-path refs, absent on a failed run; a
``model_validator`` pins status↔outputs consistency (safety rule 6). ``previewRef`` stays
optional even on success (nice-to-have, not a core output).
BlenderReport.title: BlenderReport

ErrorCategory.description: Closed coarse error-category set (§17) — the routing/telemetry grouping for a code.
ErrorCategory.title: ErrorCategory

ErrorCode.description:
Closed, stable per-stage error code set (§17).

Within-version PRODUCER contract: the sidecar emits only these codes; an out-of-enum
value is rejected at the boundary (deterministic validation, safety rule 6).

CONSUMERS (the 0.6 TS codegen type + engine/UI switch logic) MUST treat any unrecognized
code as ``SYSTEM`` for forward compatibility, so a future additive split is non-breaking;
that tolerance is tested where consumers live, not here.

``PROVIDER_AUTH_QUOTA`` groups auth (401) and quota/billing (402); the 401-vs-402
distinction is preserved in ``ErrorEnvelope.maintainerDetail`` at emit time.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorEnvelope.description:
Frozen error contract (§17, §4): SSE ``error``, ``Step.error``, ``ValidationResult``.

Field names are camelCase to match the JSON/TS wire form (§4) — no alias indirection.
``extra="forbid"`` rejects unknown fields at the boundary (frozen §2.5-seam, safety rule 6).
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

ExportJob.description:
Inputs the sidecar hands the @s4tk export worker (§9). ``geomBytesRef`` is the §8 output
threaded through (the §8↔§9 GEOM-bytes flow); ``textures`` are scratch refs; ``tuningEdits`` is
the open OBJD-tuning edit bag; ``targetTGIKeys`` are the target resource keys.
ExportJob.title: ExportJob

ExportJobReport.description:
The §9 export-worker result — renamed from the arch's ``ExportReport`` to disambiguate from
the §12 domain ``ExportReport`` (0.4a, frozen; different concern: human-readable summary).
``packagePath`` is a scratch-path ref, absent on a total failure; a ``model_validator`` pins
status↔outputs consistency (safety rule 6): ``succeeded`` ⟹ packagePath present AND error None;
``partial`` ⟹ packagePath present (a partial result MAY carry an ``error`` describing the
per-item failure); ``failed`` ⟹ error present.
ExportJobReport.title: ExportJobReport

ExportJobStatus.description:
Terminal status of a Sims export job (§9). ``partial`` = some per-item packages complete-and-
valid while others failed (never a half-written file). Distinct from the domain ``ExportState``
(the node's rollup on ``ExportArtifact``); the node MAPS this onto that.
ExportJobStatus.title: ExportJobStatus

ExportMode.description: A FunctionalOverlay's export mode — the decor/functional/both closed set (§12).
ExportMode.title: ExportMode

ExportResponse.description: EXPORT — the export artifact handle (embeds the ExportReport summary).
ExportResponse.title: ExportResponse

FunctionalOverlay.description: Behavior on the SAME item identity (Inv 2): sourceItemId is a ref, never a duplicate.
FunctionalOverlay.title: FunctionalOverlay

GateKind.description:
The 5 ordered approval gates (plan→concept→mesh→overlay→export; safety rule 6).

A protocol/workflow concept (which gate the run is paused at) — defined here, not a 0.4
domain-entity field.
GateKind.title: GateKind

GateMetrics.description:
The §8 game-ready gate metrics: pass/fail flags + counts. ``normals`` (recalc/transfer — S4S
drops normals), ``uv`` (uv_0 + uv_1 present), ``lods`` (LOD + shadow-LOD count), ``polyByTile``
(per-tile poly budget, ~2000 tris/tile LOD0), ``meshgroups`` (meshgroup-count match).
GateMetrics.title: GateMetrics

GateResponse.description: GATE — returns the advanced run state after the gate decision is applied.
GateResponse.title: GateResponse

HealthResponse.description: GET /health response (§4/§6) — carries the negotiated contractVersion.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

IpcRequestHeaders.description:
Per-request wire headers (§4/§16): ``token`` on every request, ``idempotencyKey`` on
mutating commands (the header names are TOKEN_HEADER / IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HEADER).
IpcRequestHeaders.title: IpcRequestHeaders

ItemSpec.description: The stable item identity. archetype/placementCategory are open-registry keys (str).
ItemSpec.title: ItemSpec

ItemState.description: 13 base states + 6 audit-added (R-d). The contract holds all 19; transitions are Phase-2.
ItemState.title: ItemState

ListProjectsResponse.description: LIST_PROJECTS — the page of projects + pagination echo (mirrors ListProjectsRequest).
ListProjectsResponse.title: ListProjectsResponse

LogLevel.description: Wire-level log severity for the SSE ``log`` event (protocol concept, not a 0.4 enum).
LogLevel.title: LogLevel

MeshState.description: Overall MeshCandidate state; qa + cleanup are separate axes (QaStatus / CleanupStatus).
MeshState.title: MeshState

PollResult.description:
The result of polling a provider job (§7): ``status`` plus, where available, a [0,1]
progress fraction, the output ``urls`` (on success), the ``usage`` carrier, and — on a failed
or expired poll — the 0.2 ``ErrorEnvelope`` (§17 single failure contract, never re-rolled).
PollResult.title: PollResult

PollStatus.description:
The lifecycle of an async provider job (§7). ``expired`` covers the Tripo 24h URL-expiry
race explicitly; adapters collapse provider-specific queue states onto submitted/running.
PollStatus.title: PollStatus

ProviderJobRef.description:
The reconcile-spine handle to an async provider job (§7) — persisted in graph State +
Postgres so a resume can poll/re-fetch. ``expiresAt`` drives the Tripo 24h re-download race.
ProviderJobRef.title: ProviderJobRef

ProviderUsage.description:
Cost+latency carrier for a cloud op (§7/§21). ``latencyMs`` MUST be recorded for every cloud
op; ``costCents`` SHOULD be (nullable — falls back to the §21 price-table estimate).
ProviderUsage.title: ProviderUsage

RegenerateResponse.description: REGENERATE — async job started; the regenerated candidate streams via SSE.
RegenerateResponse.title: RegenerateResponse

RegistryFinding.title: RegistryFinding

RegistryIssue.description: The closed set of load-time registry issues (structural only — Q2 scope).
RegistryIssue.title: RegistryIssue

RuleSpec.description:
One rule in a registry entry's rule list — a thin open envelope: a ``kind`` tag + an open
``params`` bag. The tuning-graft/eligibility grammar is pinned by spike S3; this stays flexible
so the freeze doesn't pre-empt the spike (the §11 analogue of the open-key rule).
RuleSpec.title: RuleSpec

RunResponse.description: START_OR_RESUME_RUN — returns the run that was started/resumed; candidates stream via SSE.
RunResponse.title: RunResponse

SettingsResponse.description: GET/PUT /settings — the protocol settings view. Secrets NEVER ride here (safety rule 5).
SettingsResponse.title: SettingsResponse

Severity.description: ValidationResult severity (§17 ⊃ the IPC ValidationEvent severity, tightened in 0.4b).
Severity.title: Severity

StepState.description: The 8-state Run/Step machine (PipelineRun.status + Step.state share it).
StepState.title: StepState

Swatch.description: A color/texture preset of one mesh (Sims-native, embedded under AssetVariant).
Swatch.title: Swatch

TestInstallResponse.description: TEST_INSTALL — async run; the install result streams via SSE.
TestInstallResponse.title: TestInstallResponse

TestProviderResponse.description: TEST_PROVIDER — connectivity probe; ``error`` carries the 0.2 ErrorEnvelope on failure.
TestProviderResponse.title: TestProviderResponse
